title: Teleport OP
features:
🧪 Compatibility
KRNL ✅   Delta ✅
Xeno ✅   Drift ✅
Solara ✅  Fluxus Z ✅
JJSploit ✅   Codex [IDK]
Ronix ✅    Seliware [IDK]

✨ Features
📍 Save & Teleport System
Save your current position with one click (+ button)

Automatically names saved points (📍 Point 1, 📍 Point 2, etc.)

Teleport to any saved point instantly

Dropdown menu to select saved locations

List view with click-to-select interface

🗑 Point Management
Delete individual points by re-saving? (optional)

Trash button (🗑) – Clear ALL saved points instantly

🧠 Anti-Cheat Bypass (Smart Teleport)
Uses intelligent movement masking

Temporarily disables collision on body parts

Adds micro‑shifts after teleport to simulate natural movement

Prevents rubberbanding and anti‑cheat flags

Tested on modern Roblox anti‑exploit systems

🖱️ Draggable GUI
Fully draggable by the title bar

Retro‑hacker aesthetic (green on black, pixel style)

Responsive and lightweight

❌ Close Button
Cleanly destroys the GUI when not needed

🎮 Auto‑Character Detection
Automatically waits for character spawn

Reconnects after death/respawn

No errors, no crashes

⚙️ Performance Optimized
No lag, no memory leaks

Uses task.wait() for smooth execution

Efficient UI updates.
